scope: Read-only static asset audit; no project files/assets modified, no Blender execution, no GPU/FPS measurements.
method: Parse GLB v2 JSON and BIN chunks with Python standard library, read POSITION/index/TEXCOORD_0 accessors, SHA-256 compare with upstream. No geometry compression extension present.

assets.name: archive-cassette.glb

rows.name: Case pressed lip outer upper left.012

assets.vertex_definition: Sum of POSITION accessor counts per primitive; exported vertices include normal/UV splits. Not Blender unique topology vertices.
assets.uv_caveat: UV0 presence is not bake readiness. Original cube/curve UVs overlap after material merging; authored annular meshes lack UVs. Exact duplicate nondegenerate UV triangles and degenerate UV triangles quantify only part of overlap; no comprehensive UV overlap raster test was run. Need dedicated packed UVs for texture baking; an additional independent nonoverlapping set is needed if storing an assembled/static AO map.

hotspots.notes: Includes facade mullions, annular lips, ribbon edges; optimize detail/viewer rather than claiming this accelerates baseline array.

hotspots.candidate: LOD with unbeveled boxes would have 135*12 = 1620 triangles for the ribs if retained individually; bake tiny bevel highlights into a normal map or remove ribs only at distant LOD. This is a geometric estimate, not an implemented visual-equivalence result.
Reduce 128-segment circular profiles and 64x10 service torus in distant LOD while preserving outer silhouette and original section/hard-normal intent.

baking_candidates.candidate: Cover engraving routes, pressed lips, embossed vertical lettering, tiny vent channels
baking_candidates.potential: baseColor + tangent normal + roughness atlas on an interior detail carrier or correctly placed cover inner surface
baking_candidates.constraints: Keep these underneath real frosted cover so top-to-bottom reveal still occludes/reveals them. Do not move them outside the cover or bake them onto a different exploded assembly part. The outer rim/screw holes/flush top index affect silhouette and remain geometric at close LOD.

baking_candidates.candidate: Facade mullion bevels, tiny annular machining lips, fastener cross slots/chamfers
baking_candidates.potential: Normal/roughness bake can remove fine geometry on medium/far LOD; preserve coarse ring and screw volume
baking_candidates.constraints: 135 repeated mullions are merged into optical-core material, so reauthor from Blender generator before final joining. Close 360/exploded views require side profiles and separation; full flat impostor is unsuitable there.

baking_candidates.potential: Only part-local cavity AO where geometry within that part remains fixed
baking_candidates.constraints: Whole-assembly baked inter-part AO becomes stale when exploded and as cover moves; animated wave/selection self-shadow and transmitted background are not generally bakeable.

baking_candidates.potential: Already CanvasTexture; keep as separate dynamic texture
baking_candidates.constraints: Do not bake per-archive code/title into shared atlas. Carbon_Ink GLB primitive is runtime-unused, removable from future export to save 157152 raw accessor bytes but no current draw cost.

baking_candidates.potential: Optional pre-rendered interior color/normal approximation under a real coarse shell
baking_candidates.constraints: Use only for sufficiently small projected size and limited angle; cannot preserve full 360 perspective/parallax/transmission at medium/near view. Current array already includes explicit interior surfaces.

lod_recommendation.topology: Separate instanced batches by LOD/material for array; keep selected/returning/dragged/shelf-owned cassette quality transitions coherent. Use projected size plus active interaction state and hysteresis, not distance alone with long-lens and responsive zoom.
lod_recommendation.levels: LOD0 near/clear/360 retains six assemblyPart groups and authored ring cross sections; LOD1 reduces procedural segment/bevel counts and bakes planar microdetail; LOD2 far array coarse opaque interior + real coarse shell. Targets require measured visual/error comparison.
lod_recommendation.instancing: Array already has eight InstancedMesh batches. Extra per-rib runtime instancing alone would reduce duplicate geometry buffers but add batching/matrix complexity and does not remove vertices processed; generator-level simplification/LOD is the clearer first pass.
lod_recommendation.asset_compression: Meshopt/Draco affect transfer/decode, not a substitute for fewer triangles/passes. KTX2/BasisU matters after texture bake; current assets have zero images/textures.
lod_recommendation.material_names: Current runtime branches on material names after numeric-suffix stripping. Preserve or explicitly remap semantic surface names and assemblyPart extras during atlas/mesh consolidation.
lod_recommendation.transparency: Do not dither two overlapping transmissive covers during LOD change; retain one shell ownership as current CardAppearance does. Preserve local y/3.7 reveal coordinate.
lod_recommendation.roughness_shader_integration: appearance.ts:65-68 overwrites roughnessFactor after roughnessmap_fragment with the animated frosted/clear scalar. A roughness texture attached to the cover alone would therefore not survive that assignment; adapt combination deliberately or bake microdetails on a distinct interior surface.

source_reproduction.pipeline: build_archive.py executes clear_reference_details.py, which executes internal_architecture.py and shell_reference_details.py; applies text/curve conversion and bevels, joins by material, doubles depth, exports GLB and .blend. build_assembly.py runs same geometry prefix, removes Carbon_Ink, groups by assemblyPart + material and exports extras. Existing sources have no texture image baking/unwrapping/LOD generation pipeline.
